title: US Consumer Spending Jumps by Most in a Year

US consumer spending rose in August at the fastest pace in over a year, helping to power the economy through persistent inflation. Bruce Markets CEO Jason Wallach joins Bloomberg News' Bernard Goyder to discuss the company's role in Robinhood Markets' plan to debut weekend equity trading. Jennifer Palmer, Founder & CEO at JPalmer Collective, discusses the evolving non-bank lending landscape. All on the latest episode of "Bloomberg Businessweek Daily."
